report:
Right ilium and acetabulum, segmental / wide resection

Received in formalin is a segmental / wide resection specimen of the right ilium and acetabulum measuring 20 x 14 x 10 cm (internal hemipelvectomy specimen). Sectioning shows a lobulated blue-grey cartilaginous tumour measuring 115 x 85 x 70 mm. The tumour destroys the cortex and extends into the adjacent soft tissue. Macroscopically, the tumour lies 2 mm from the closest (posterior sacral osteotomy margin) margin. Representative sections are taken in 14 blocks after formic acid decalcification.

(1-10) Tumour.
(11-12) Osteotomy margins.
(13-14) Soft tissue margins.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Segmental / wide resection
- Tumour site: Pelvis (right ilium and acetabulum)
- Tumour location and extent: Medullary cavity; Cortical; Tumour extension into
  soft tissue
- Tumour size: 115 mm (greatest dimension)
  - All dimensions: 115 x 85 x 70 mm
- Pelvic extent: Spans 2 pelvic segments with extraosseous extension

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Chondrosarcoma
- Histologic grade: G2: Moderately differentiated, high grade
- Mitotic rate: 4 per 10 HPF
- Necrosis (in absence of neoadjuvant therapy): Present (15%)
- Treatment effect: No known presurgical therapy
- Lymphovascular invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified
- Tumour histology:
  Sections of the right ilium and acetabulum show chondrosarcoma. Lobules of malignant hyaline cartilage show increased cellularity, nuclear atypia, binucleation and permeation of host bone trabeculae with entrapment of pre-existing bone.

Margins
- Surgical margins: Uninvolved by tumour
  - Posterior osteotomy: Uninvolved, 2 mm (block 11)
  - Anterior pubis osteotomy: Uninvolved, 18 mm (block 12)
  - Soft tissue: Uninvolved, 10 mm (block 13)

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: pT3b

Additional findings
- Preresection treatment: No known preresection therapy

Molecular studies
- IDH1 / IDH2: IDH1 mutation detected

RIGHT ILIUM AND ACETABULUM, segmental / wide resection:
- CHONDROSARCOMA, grade 2, 115 mm
- Margins clear (closest 2 mm, posterior osteotomy)
- pT3b (AJCC 8th edition).
